crossRefs.note: Yahweh your God will raise up to you a prophet from among you, of your brothers, like me. You shall listen to him.
but with those who stand here with us today before Yahweh our God, and also with those who are not here with us today
but if you refuse and rebel, you will be devoured with the sword; for the mouth of Yahweh has spoken it.”
Woe to the wicked! Disaster is upon them; for the deeds of his hands will be paid back to him.
but to those who are self-seeking, and don’t obey the truth, but obey unrighteousness, will be wrath, indignation,
oppression, and anguish on every soul of man who does evil, to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.
Isn’t their tent cord plucked up within them? They die, and that without wisdom.’
Jesus said therefore again to them, “I am going away, and you will seek me, and you will die in your sins. Where I go…

translations.web: But if they don’t listen, they will perish by the sword; they will die without knowledge.
translations.bsb: But if they do not obey, then they perish by the sword and die without knowledge.
translations.kjv: But if they obey not, they shall perish by the sword, and they shall die without knowledge.
translations.asv: But if they hearken not, they shall perish by the sword, And they shall die without knowledge.
